journal.title: Day journal

best.title: The best day
best.text: Solomiia's grandma invites everyone to dinner: you, Solomiia and the artist from Mury. Grandma Nina, Mrs Halyna and Ostap wave to you on the embankment. The city remembers you.

good.title: A good day
good.text: Solomiia invites you to dinner with her family. Tomorrow — a trip to Pyrohov's estate.

basic.title: You made it
basic.text: The main thing is that you are here. Next time Solomiia will give you a proper tour of the city.

journal.noWords: No new words this time — try the exercises in dialogues.
journal.noHelped: Nobody yet. Next time, help someone along the way.
